author: Aletheia I
title: Aletheia I - MPB-GraphFWPCA (CC Regress, Delta 0.05)
abstract: An iterative submission integrating cell cycle regression into the MPB-GraphFWPCA SOTA workflow. After log-normalization, cell cycle effects are regressed out using `sc.tl.score_genes_cell_cycle` and `sc.pp.regress_out`. This modified preprocessing then feeds into the MPB-GraphFWPCA method with `delta=0.05`. The goal is to investigate if explicit cell cycle handling can improve `ASW_label` and `Cell_cycle` conservation while maintaining the SOTA's high overall integration quality.

original_submission.content:
import sys
import anndata as ad
sys.path.append('storage/aletheia') # Ensure it finds my local copy of helper modules
from mpb_graphfwpca_ccreg import eliminate_mpb_graphfwpca_ccreg

def eliminate_batch_effect_fn(adata: ad.AnnData) -> ad.AnnData:
    print("Aletheia I: Testing MPB-GraphFWPCA with Cell Cycle Regression and delta=0.05.")
    return eliminate_mpb_graphfwpca_ccreg(
        adata,
        lam_override=0.605,
        delta=0.05, # Optimal delta from previous tuning
        kdensity=22,
        k_total=50,
        cap=2.0,
        rng_seed=0
    )
